description: Together SDK chat completion, one turn, traced by OpenInference through cetra's SDK.
notes: The Together client sends chat to https://api-inference.together.ai (its default chat host), and the harness routes the request to the capture mock under that host (D-IN-3). The instrumentor writes llm.provider together, which resolves to together_ai through the alias list (D-IN-2). Cost is computed, not reported. Token counts are input 14 and output 8.

message.text: The capital of France is Paris.
